name: review
title: Code review
description: A change's diff with the comments a reviewer agent proposes to post, each accepted or rejected before anything is posted.
use_when: You reviewed a merge or pull request and want a person to approve each comment before it is posted to the forge.

shortcuts.does: Reject the focused proposal, with a reason
Write a note to the agent on the focused finding
Review what goes back and hand over
Wrap long lines or scroll sideways

diff.title: Diff
diff.description: How a file's changes are laid out

wrap.title: Wrap long lines
wrap.description: Long lines carry on underneath; off, a file scrolls sideways (inline diff only)

order.title: File order
order.description: The order the agent suggests, or by path; a change without an order is by path

findings_only.title: Only files with findings
findings_only.description: Hide files the agent had nothing to say about

tree_open.title: File tree open
tree_open.description: Start with the file tree beside the diff
